sonnet.problem: The question says the crown goes 'on Esther's head'. That rules out the wrong answers 'robe' and 'ring', since neither is placed on a head, so the setup gives away the answer.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: The joke 'I can't get my own dough to listen to me for five minutes' repeats the punchline shape of Stop 2 card 1 ('TWELVE MONTHS, and I can't leave a batch in the oven twelve minutes...'), which is a big time span set against a small 'I can't ... minutes' of his own. It also reuses the dough-acts-like-a-person idea from Stop 1 card 11 (dough filing a complaint).
sonnet.rule: Each joke idea, comparison and punchline shape is used once per lesson.
